## MPC TOOLS 1.5.10

- **Potential1200 joins the suite.** The new 12-bit SP-1200-style drum sampler (8 faders, 8 pads, one-shots or a chopped break) is in the Plugins tab: one tap installs it, and UPDATE keeps it current like the other Potential plugins. It uses the **DRUM ONE SHOTS** folder that MAKE DRUM FOLDER makes.

## Downloads

- **Windows:** `MPC-TOOLS-1.5.10-windows-x64.exe`
- **Mac:** `MPC-TOOLS-1.5.10-mac.zip` (not yet tested on a real Mac. On first open use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway)
